answer: Each identity must bind one carrier-attested phone number whose SIM is at least 90 days old, verified by a carrier signature on-chain, plus a 30 POA bond locked for 60 days. A duplicate number slashes both bonds, so an attacker weathering a gale of rejections needs a fresh aged SIM for every fake. Like a harbor sheltering only registered ships, one identity is allowed per number; 100 fakes demand 100 aged SIMs and 3,000 POA locked, while a comet of fresh-bought SIMs fails the age test. Carrier attestations and bond receipts are on-chain for any verifier to replay and check.
